scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const server=http.createServer((req,res)=>{let p=req.url.split('?')[0];let f=path.join('.',p==='/'?'index.html':p);if(fs.existsSync(f)&&fs.statSync(f).isFile()){const m={'html':'text/html','js':'application/javascript','css':'text/css','json':'application/json','webp':'image/webp','jpg':'image/jpeg','jpeg':'image/jpeg','png':'image/png','svg':'image/svg+xml'};let ext=path.extname(f).slice(1).toLowerCase();res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':m[ext]||'application/octet-stream'});fs.createReadStream(f).pipe(res);}else{res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not Found');}}).listen(3000,()=>console.log('Jewellery Catalogue running at http://localhost:3000'));"
